initial_inventory.title: [SM70][Gemma4] V100 support: D=512 attention, transformers heterogeneity, gemma4_unified port

metadata.title: [SM70][Gemma4] V100 support: D=512 attention, transformers heterogeneity, gemma4_unified port
metadata.body:
## Purpose

Add Gemma-4 serving support on V100 (sm70). Gemma-4's full-attention layers use `head_dim=512`, which exceeds the 256-dim cap of existing FlashAttention paths. This PR adds native D=512 SM70 CUDA kernels, fixes the transformers ≥5.6 per-layer attribute system that blocks Gemma-4 config loading, and ports the `gemma4_unified` (12B dense+audio) variant.

## Changes

- **D=512 SM70 kernels** (`flash_v100/`): Add `BLOCK_M_512`/`BLOCK_N_512` tiling, `LAUNCH_XQA_WIDE(GROUP_SIZE, 512)`, and `case 512:` dispatches to the existing paged prefill/decode kernels.
- **Transformers heterogeneity** (`gemma4.py`, `gemma4_mtp.py`, `model_arch_config_convertor.py`): Set `allow_global_per_layer_attribute_access = True` in the convertor; use `config.__dict__` and `per_layer_config[layer_type]` access instead of the old `getattr` escape-hatch pattern.
- **Restore raw config fields** (`model_arch_config_convertor.py`): Preserve `global_head_dim` / `num_global_key_value_heads` from the checkpoint's `config.json` through the convertor.
- **Dynamo compatibility** (`sm70_grouped_long.py`, `sm70_grouped_scalar.py`, `platforms/cuda.py`): Replace `@lru_cache`/`@cache` with plain dict caches so CUDA graph capture doesn't hit C-level `_lru_cache_wrapper` objects.
- **gemma4_unified port** (`gemma4_unified.py`, `gemma3n_mm.py`, `gpu_sync_debug.py`, `envs.py`): Copy from upstream + register in model registry, config convertor, and `VERIFY_UPDATE_CONFIG`.

## Quantization support

| Method | Status |
|--------|--------|
| NVFP4 (compressed-tensors, `config_groups`) | Tested — [Gemma-4-26B-A4B-StyleTune-V2-NVFP4-W4ATTN-AWQ](https://huggingface.co/TheUnderscore/Gemma-4-26B-A4B-StyleTune-V2-NVFP4-W4ATTN-AWQ) + [gemma-4-12b-it-NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-NVFP4) |
| WNA16 (compressed-tensors) | Tested — routes to generic fused MoE kernel (not SM70 per-expert dispatch); ~420× slower per call. Fix planned in a separate PR. |
| AWQ (`quant_method: "awq"`) | Expected to work (routes to SM70 per-expert dispatch); untested |
| BF16 | Expected to work; untested |

## Test Plan

- 26B-A4B NVFP4: multi-length prompt test (500–30K tokens), TP2, V100-SXM2-16GB.
- 12B unified NVFP4: multi-length prompt test (500–30K tokens), TP2, V100-SXM2-16GB.

## Test Result

Hardware: 2× V100-SXM2-16GB (underclocked to 765 MHz / 150 W), TP2.

- 26B-A4B NVFP4: all 6 prompt lengths (500/2K/5K/10K/20K/30K) produce coherent, correct responses. Prefill ~5K tok/s, decode ~35 tok/s. Math reasoning test (solve 2^(x^1.5)=3) produces correct step-by-step derivation (x ≈ 1.351).
- 12B unified NVFP4: coherent, correct responses at all tested lengths. Prefill ~2500 tok/s, decode ~38 tok/s. Math reasoning test produces correct step-by-step derivation.
- 31B (dense): not tested (insufficient VRAM on 2×16 GB).
- E2B/E4B: not supported — `KeyError: 'embed_tokens_per_layer.weight_packed'` during NVFP4 weight load (per-layer embedding layout not handled).

## Duplicate-work check

Searched open PRs for: `gemma`, `gemma4`, `head_dim 512`, `flash_v100 sm70`, `heterogeneity per-layer`. No other open PR addresses Gemma-4 V100 support, D=512 SM70 kernels, or the transformers heterogeneity fix.

## AI assistance

This PR was developed with AI assistance (Pi-Bolt coding agent). The human submitter reviewed every changed line and ran all listed tests.

## Test commands

```bash
# Pre-commit / CI checks
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_metadata.py
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check
python -m tools.generate_architecture_reference --check
python -m tools.config_inventory --check

# Runtime tests (require GPU)
python -m pytest tests/config/test_runtime_default_ownership.py -q
python -m pytest tests/config/test_sm70_native_runtime.py tests/config/test_flash_v100_lifecycle.py -q
```
